answer: Sybil resistance follows from a reputation horizon governed by exponential temporal decay: each score loses half its weight every fixed interval, so an identity must provide sustained, corroborated honest service to accumulate influence. A freshly spawned sybil begins near the nadir, with near-zero EigenTrust eigenvector centrality and negligible reciprocal trust; splitting identities cannot amplify normalized mass, and thus cannot pass consensus, even behind an ivory façade.
